subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

INCORPORATE
solution:
The correct answer is: exclude

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Incorporate means to include something within something else.

 
 
• Example - *I’d like you to **incorporate **this information into your report.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Exclude **means to keep out or omit something or someone.
 
 
• Example - *The price **excludes **all extras such as drinks or excursions.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Incorporate' and 'Exclude' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 1.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Assimilate means to become or allow somebody/something to become part of a country, a social group, etc.
 
• Absorb means to take something in, especially gradually.
 
• Integrate means to join things so that they become one thing or work together.
